integrity: The unrestricted statement is proved symbolically from the beat-point definitions. Exhaustive enumeration through five points and three suspension iterates is used only as an independent regression check; it is not extrapolated to untested sizes. The original Stong full text was not available in directly inspectable full text from the sources used for this review, and that access limitation is retained as an originality risk.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns nonempty finite \(T_0\)-spaces and the non-Hausdorff suspension \(\mathbb S X=X\oplus S^0\). It does not assert an analogous formula for arbitrary ordinal sums, weak-point reductions, or minimal finite models under weak homotopy equivalence.
title: Non-Hausdorff suspension commutes with Stong cores away from the contractible case
